## Current position

### L3 Escalation Engineer — Fortinet

Period: August 2019 to present  
Location: Prague, Czechia

Konstantinos works as a highest-level technical escalation engineer before R&D involvement. His role includes resolving complex, high-impact technical cases, analyzing diagnostic data, reproducing customer environments in controlled lab setups, troubleshooting enterprise security products, and validating integrations across email, authentication, networking, logging, and threat protection technologies.

Representative areas of responsibility include:

- Advanced troubleshooting for enterprise security products
- Root-cause analysis of complex customer issues

## Previous experience

### Network Support Analyst — AT&T

Period: October 2018 to August 2019  
Location: Brno, Czechia

Konstantinos worked on end-to-end network troubleshooting across OSI Layers 1 to 3, including incident investigation, fault isolation, service recovery, and SLA-driven resolution. The role involved diagnosing transport, routing, switching, and enterprise connectivity issues in production environments.

### IT Manager & Network System Administrator — Skiathos Palace

Period: April 2018 to September 2018  
Location: Skiathos, Greece

Konstantinos managed hotel IT and network operations, including wired and wireless infrastructure, routing, switching, segmentation, server maintenance, and day-to-day operational support.

Technical areas included:

## Technical skills

### Email security and secure mail systems

FortiMail, email gateways, mail-flow troubleshooting, TLS, DKIM, SPF, DMARC, DLP, IBE, SAML SSO, Microsoft Exchange, Office 365, and Google Workspace.

### Network and security engineering

SSL, encryption technologies, security certificates, packet analysis, firewalls, LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, routing, switching, VLANs, and protocol-level troubleshooting.

### Advanced threat protection

FortiSandbox, malware analysis, MITRE ATT&CK reporting, YARA rules, ICAP, JSON APIs, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSIEM, syslog, CEF, and security telemetry integrations.

### Automation and development

Python, PowerShell, C#, .NET, API automation, troubleshooting utilities, diagnostic scripts, lab workflow automation, and custom support tools.

### Authentication and access control

LDAP, SAML, RADIUS, identity-based access, directory synchronization, authentication flows, group mapping, and SSO troubleshooting.

### Virtualization and cloud

VMware, Hyper-V, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, and lab-based replication of customer environments.
